Definition: properly, to miscarry, i.e. suffer abortion; by analogy, to bereave (literally or figuratively)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be bereaved, make childless, miscarry; 1a) (Qal) to be bereaved; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to make childless; 1b2) to cause barrenness, show barrenness or abortion; 1b3) to miscarry; 1c) (Hiphil) miscarrying (participle)
